description: This PHP source file defines the Backup class within the OpenCart admin system that manages the backup process, including scheduling backup tasks and writing backup data to storage.

classes.name: Backup
classes.description: A controller class handling backup task scheduling and execution within OpenCart's admin system.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Generates a list of backup tasks based on provided arguments, splitting large tables into manageable chunks.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Performs the actual backup of a specific table starting at a given offset, exporting data to a backup file.
